provider: Tencent Cloud Agent Runtime  -  Agent Sandbox

free_tier.stated: no free tier: CPU bills at CNY 0.000081 a core-second from a successful start to a stop; a paused instance stops CPU and memory billing and pays only the storage its state needs

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: CNY 0.000081 a core-second, billed from a successful start to a stop
a paused instance stops CPU and memory billing and continues to pay for the storage its state needs; waking resumes compute billing
the document's own 30-day example for 1 core always-on is CNY 69.98, and for 2 cores CNY 419.90

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: not documented. email is the assumed default because priced hosts require an account; sign-up requirements are unconfirmed for this provider.

reliability_note: no reliability event recorded in the source passes
confidence_note: the billing document was read on 2026-10-22 (Chinese, updated 2026-10-10) and states the per-second CPU rate, the pause semantics and a 30-day worked example. There is no free tier, so the claim is contradicted and the verdict moves to paid-only

evidence.proved: listed in the peli-cloud corpus card at commit f6a71ab0; the card is the source, not the vendor page

'按 **实际运行时长** 及 **资源规格** 计费。实例 **启动成功后开始计费**，**停止后停止计费**'  -  billed on actual runtime and spec, from a successful start to a stop  -  with 'CPU 0.000081 元 / 核 / 秒' and '暂停期间 CPU、内存停止计费，保留状态所需存储继续计费，唤醒后计算资源重新计费', quoted

extras.keep_rate_basis: billed for uptime (no suspension feature published)

shape.note: the document's worked example bills 1 core for 28,800 seconds a day at CNY 69.98 a month

session_cap.note: no vendor reap: billing runs from start to stop, and pause keeps state for a storage charge

extras.price_note: a price without a shape and a horizon is not a price; both columns are kept because the two seed models disagree and neither is wrong
extras.free_tier_kind_basis: decided from the page read on 2026-10-22
